sample_unit: expert physician reviews of AI recommendations

links.outcome: Expert physician agreement with AI-generated NCD recommendations
links.effect: 67.0% Agreed, 26.3% Partially Agreed, 6.7% Disagreed (93.3% overall agreement); most disagreements were in medication and treatment plan recommendations.
links.quote: Expert validation showed high acceptance of AI-generated recommendations, with 67.0% “Agreed,” 26.3% “Partially Agreed,” and only 6.7% “Disagreed,” yielding 93.3% overall (partial or full) agreement.

links.outcome: Workflow fit barriers to AI-CDSS adoption identified in qualitative interviews
links.effect: Duplicative data entry from parallel paper-based workflows was the main impediment to adoption amid high patient volumes.
links.quote: Qualitative findings identified operational challenges particularly duplicative data entry arising from parallel paper-based workflows as the main impediment to NCDAI adoption amid high patient volumes.

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility, acceptance, and workflow integration (via expert review of LLM-RAG recommendations and clinician surveys/interviews) in Kenya, but does not compare outcomes with vs without a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
